name: Billtrust
summary: Billtrust is an enterprise AR platform for companies that invoice through many customer AP portals. It delivers invoices by email, print, mail and more than 260 AP portals, scores payment matches by confidence so teams can tune the exceptions queue, and builds scheduled collections reports that include aging balances. No prices are published, and the site has no pricing page.

facts.text: Billtrust says it delivers invoices across email, print, mail and 260+ AP portals, and that portal submissions carry a two-day service-level agreement.
Billtrust's collections FAQ says the software automates tasks such as sending payment reminders and tracking account statuses.
Billtrust's cash application page says matches carry confidence scores and that teams can adjust the threshold to change how many exceptions are flagged for manual follow-up.
A Billtrust blog post says collection teams can create reports on actuals, aging balances and team performance, and schedule them daily, weekly or monthly.
The platform page says its solutions are SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI DSS Level 1 and ISO 27001 certified. The same page gives two connector counts, 200+ in one place and 40+ pre-built connectors in its FAQ.

hiddenCosts: No prices, plan names or pricing page appear on the site. The main call to action is 'Talk to an expert'.
